A family is grieving the loss of their loved one at the hands of an illegal immigrant yet Chicago’s mayor is celebrating a snowplow named “Abolish ICE.”

Tone-deaf and deeply irresponsible. Americans deserve leaders who take the safety of our communities seriously.


R A W S A L E R T S (@rawsalerts)

It was my honor to introduce Sheria Clarke to the Senate Judiciary Committee at her nomination hearing to serve as a United States District Judge for the District of South Carolina.

Sheria is not only an accomplished attorney, but a dedicated public servant, and devoted mother.

Her professional accomplishments, outstanding character, and commitment to service leaves me with no doubt she will be an outstanding addition to the judiciary!

South Carolina is proud to be home to @BMW's largest global manufacturing facility, and it was my pleasure to meet with BMW Chairman Oliver Zipse and other members of the BMW Group.

It’s always great to discuss further opportunities for our partnership to drive economic growth for workers and families in the Palmetto State!

It was a blessing to welcome students and educators from Cross Schools in Bluffton, SC to our nation’s capital. When our young people have access to an education centered in faith, service, and excellence, their future is incredibly bright!

Democrats must end the chaos and fund DHS!


Bill Melugin (@BillMelugin_)

As our nation’s highest decoration for valor, the Medal of Honor represents courage, selflessness, and sacrifice. A grateful nation thanks them for their service and unwavering commitment to our great nation.

I had the pleasure of meeting the wonderful women of @dstinc1913. These women show that sisterhood rooted in scholarship, service, and advocacy can make a major impact in South Carolina, DC, and across the country!
 
Certainly glad I wore my red tie today!

Fund DHS. Protect American lives.


Fox News (@FoxNews)

Happy National Ag Day!

In South Carolina, we know our farmers are the backbone of our communities. Thanks to the Working Families Tax Cut, farmers and their families in the Palmetto State will see $49 million in savings on crop insurance - delivering real relief for those who feed and fuel America.

Congratulations to @USCAiken women’s polo team on their national championship victory! What an incredible performance - way to represent the Palmetto State.


USC Aiken (@USCAiken)

Our women’s polo team claimed the national title after a dominant 15–6 victory over Texas A&M at the 2026 USPA Division I National Intercollegiate Championship in Dallas.

Join us in congratulating these ladies on an unforgettable season and championship win! 🏇🏆

We’ll miss him in the Senate, but I have no doubt he’ll lead DHS with the utmost commitment to ensuring the safety and security of our nation.
